question: Which of the following is NOT responsible for investigating complaints of violations of human rights in India?

options.text: National Human Rights Commission of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**International Human Rights Commission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **International Human Rights Commission (IHRC)** is a global organization and does not have jurisdiction to investigate human rights violations within India.
 
• Human rights complaints in India are primarily handled by national statutory bodies like the **National Human Rights Commission of India (NHRC)**.
 
• Other commissions, such as the **National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC)** and the **National Commission for Women (NCW)**, investigate rights violations specific to their respective domains in India.
 
• The IHRC is focused on international advocacy and awareness rather than direct investigation or enforcement of human rights laws in individual countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Human Rights Commission of India (NHRC):**

 
 
• Established in 1993 under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993, the NHRC is a statutory body in India.
 
• It investigates complaints of human rights violations and recommends remedial action to the government.
 
• The commission also promotes research and awareness about human rights issues in India.
 
 
 
• **National Commission for Scheduled Castes (NCSC):**
 
 
• Constituted under Article 338 of the Indian Constitution, the NCSC safeguards the rights of Scheduled Castes in India.
 
• It monitors the implementation of constitutional and legal safeguards for Scheduled Castes and investigates related complaints.
 
 
 
• **National Commission for Women (NCW):**
 
 
• Set up in January 1992, the NCW focuses on protecting and promoting the rights of women in India.
 
• It reviews laws, policies, and programs affecting women and addresses grievances related to gender discrimination and violence.
 
 
 
• **International Human Rights Commission (IHRC):**
 
 
• A non-governmental organization that works globally to promote human rights awareness and advocacy.
 
• It does not have any legislative or judicial authority to investigate or enforce human rights within sovereign states.
